newsitem.title: USA: Duty Free says knows no reason for shr rise.
newsitem.headline: Duty Free says knows no reason for shr rise.

text.p: Duty Free International Inc said Tuesday it knows of no reason to explain the recent sharp rise in its stock price, and repeated its backing of Wall Street's outlook for the company's earnings.
"We have not come out with any news, it is business as usual," a spokeswoman told Reuters.
In afternoon NYSE trade, Duty Free shares were up 1-3/8, or 7.33 percent, to 20-1/8, backing off a year-high 21 reached earlier in the day.
Since last week, the stock has risen from about 16-1/2, the ascent accompanied by unusually heavy trading volume.
